enunciado: Store functions in variables of function type and use them with map, filter and reduce over {3, 8, 1, 6, 5}: twice each element, the even ones and the total sum.
objetivos: Use higher-order functions: map, filter, reduce
pistas: function(int x) int f; declares a variable that holds a function.
filter writes into the output array and returns how many elements passed.
reduce(array, f, initial) combines all elements from left to right.
